name: SEO AI for WooCommerce
author: SEO AI Team

sections.description:
SEO AI for WooCommerce helps store owners fix two common catalog problems:

  1. Empty category pages that look unfinished and weak for SEO.
  2. Long descriptions that overwhelm shoppers on category and product pages.

Free: Fill Empty Categories

No API key required. One shared category template with variables ({category_name}, prices, and more).

  1. Open Generate SEO in the admin menu.
  2. Write or paste a category template, then Count and Preview.
  3. Approve rows and Apply — Free writes that one template into WooCommerce category descriptions (variables make each category unique).
  4. Optional: keep a runtime template for any categories that stay empty.

Includes: variable library with click-to-insert, Display Studio (collapse long text), and clear PRO upsell for AI workflows.

PRO: Bulk SEO with AI

Upgrade for unique AI-generated text per category and product, SERP packages, queue, cost estimate, and one-click rollback. Same plugin — PRO add-on sold separately.

Free features

  • Generate SEO (template) — one category template, preview, approve, and write to the database.
  • Runtime template fallback for empty product_cat pages (optional).
  • Variable library + quick phrases for store-ready wording.
  • Live preview with real category data and collapse mockup.
  • Variable library: {category_name}, {products_count}, {min_price}, {max_price}, {shop_name}, and more.
  • Optional setup wizard + victory flow after first save.
  • Text collapse for category descriptions (desktop + mobile line limits).
  • Optional collapse for product full and short descriptions.
  • Button presets, alignment, fade gradient, exclusions.
  • Shortcodes [scatseo_toggle] / [scatseo_collapse].
  • Compatible with AJAX/PJAX themes (e.g. WoodMart-style category tabs).

PRO features (add-on)

  • AI generation for categories, product descriptions, and excerpts.
  • SERP packages (title, meta, focus keyphrase) with Yoast / Rank Math adapters.
  • Batch preview, Quality Guard, cost estimate, rollback.
  • Per-category templates, {if} conditionals, bulk write to database.
  • Private updates via license server.

Privacy (Free): settings stay in your WordPress database. The free plugin does not call external APIs.

Quick Start (Free, ~60 seconds)

  1. Open Generate SEO.
  2. Paste a category template with variables (or keep the saved one).
  3. Count items, then Preview and review template.
  4. Approve all → Apply approved changes.
  5. Confirm text on a live category page.

Pass criteria: visible category text on the storefront for an empty category, without editing each category in WooCommerce.

Quick Start (PRO)

  1. Connect AI API key → test key.
  2. Count empty entities → AI preview → run batch.
  3. Rollback last batch if needed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate in Plugins (WooCommerce must be active).
  3. Open SEO AI for WooCommerce in the admin menu.
  4. Go to Generate SEO, set a category template, then Count → Preview → Approve → Apply.
  5. Open a category on the storefront to verify the description.
sections.faq:
Why are my category pages empty?

WooCommerce does not auto-fill category descriptions. This plugin shows helpful runtime text on empty categories using one template and dynamic variables — no per-category editing in Free.

Does Free write to my category descriptions in the database?

No. Free uses a runtime template (your WooCommerce category description field stays empty). PRO can bulk-write unique text to the database.

Is collapsed text safe for SEO?

Yes. Text remains in the HTML and is indexable. Collapse is for readability, not cloaking.

Does it work with AJAX themes?

Yes. Includes compatibility for dynamic content and category tab switches without full page reload.

Can I use AI in the free plugin?

AI bulk generation is PRO only. Free focuses on fill-empty templates and text collapse.

How do I add descriptions to empty WooCommerce categories?

Open Fill Empty Categories in the admin menu: pick a template style (or write your own), preview with real catalog data (name, stock count, prices), and save. One template covers every empty product_cat page on the storefront — no API key and no editing each category in WooCommerce. For unique AI-written text saved to the database, use the PRO add-on.

Can I bulk generate product and category descriptions with AI?

PRO only for unique AI text. Connect your AI provider API key, count empty categories or products, run AI preview, then apply in batch with cost estimate and one-click rollback. Free can still apply one shared category template (with variables) to WooCommerce descriptions via Preview → Approve → Apply. SERP fields (title, meta description, focus keyphrase) sync to Yoast SEO and Rank Math via PRO.
sections.changelog:
1.0.13

  • Fix: duplicate category descriptions on archives (WooCommerce taxonomy printer + plugin collapse block).
  • Category archives: plugin owns woocommerce_archive_description so text still appears when the theme does not print it; collapse JS no longer double-wraps.

1.0.12

  • Free: category template Preview → Approve → Apply now writes descriptions to WooCommerce (one shared template with variables).
  • Free: PRO upsell messaging for unique AI category/product copy, SERP, queue, and rollback.
  • Settings: AI content language/tone/length persist correctly on Free saves.
  • Admin SPA: sidebar collapse chevron centering fix.
  • WordPress.org: plugin directory screenshots 1–6.

1.0.11

  • Admin SPA: Free Generate SEO supports category template count/preview (read-only draft) without a full PRO lock screen.
  • Template editor: click-to-insert variable library (Essential / Also useful / More) plus quick phrases.
  • Display Studio polish and Russian/English admin UI language consistency for SPA strings.

1.0.10

  • Fill Empty Categories: redesigned first-time setup wizard to match plugin admin UI (rounded buttons, spacing, progress bar, step hints).
  • Admin: wizard navigation and restart link use the same design tokens as the rest of the settings page.

1.0.9

  • WordPress.org listing: short description, tags, and FAQ tuned for category/product description and fill-empty search queries (readme only; no code changes).

1.0.8

  • Fill Empty Categories: syntax highlighting for {variables}, active variable chips, and usage counter.
  • Admin: no page scroll when inserting variables or marketplace styles; client-side template validation before save.
  • Admin: rendered length hints, marketplace “Show full” preview, Ctrl+S save on the templates tab.
  • i18n: Russian strings for new Fill Empty admin UI.

1.0.7

  • Hotfix: ensure all template engine include files are packaged in the plugin zip (fixes fatal error on activation for some 1.0.6 downloads).
  • No functional changes beyond 1.0.6 when all files are present.

1.0.6

  • Free: Fill Empty Categories tab — wizard, template marketplace (9 styles), live AJAX preview, variable library, quick phrases, victory flow, See it on your store.
  • Free: tiered template variables registry + expanded runtime placeholders ({shop_name}, {currency}, {category_url}, etc.).
  • Admin: dashboard and copy aligned to “fill empty in about a minute” (Free) vs AI workspace (PRO).
  • Docs: 60-second benchmark + MVP QA checklist (docs/fill-empty-categories-mvp-checklist.md).

1.0.5

  • Admin: fixed settings save (color pickers sync before submit, no PHP warnings in inline scripts).
  • Admin: unified button style presets (Link, Outline, Filled, Pill).
  • Admin: live preview reads wpColorPicker values; preset cards update colors and preview together.
  • Frontend: PRO/custom button colors apply via dynamic CSS and toggle.js with theme-safe specificity.
  • Options: scatseo_btn_style is the source of truth; legacy scatseo_btn_preset stays in sync on save.

1.0.4

  • Fixed PRO purchase links: pricing section on smartcategoryseo.online.

1.0.3

  • Removed direct style tag output; CSS via wp_add_inline_style().
  • Cache transients regenerate automatically (no direct update_option migration).

1.0.2

  • register_setting() sanitize_callback for every option.
  • Shortcode preview escaped via wp_kses_post().

1.0.1

  • Renamed prefix scs → scatseo; migration for existing options/meta.
  • Shortcodes [scatseo_toggle] and [scatseo_collapse].

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
